title: Recessed Toilet Paper Holder 6.125-Inch Square | Matte Gray | Carolina Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Need a toilet paper holder that doesn’t crowd the space next to the toilet? This recessed toilet paper holder installs in-wall for a streamlined, built-in look with traditional Carolina Collection styling in Matte Gray, which provides a sophisticated neutral that complements concrete, stone, and other modern materials.

  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Keep the installation looking clean thanks to concealed screw mounting hardware
  • Create a coordinated bath by pairing with matching Carolina Collection pieces for classic bath accessories
  • Install with confidence—all mounting hardware is included

Specs & details

  • Product dimensions (L x H x W): 6.125 x 6.125 x 4 in.
  • Box dimensions (L x H x W): 10 x 6 x 4 in.
  • Shipping weight: 2.4 lbs
  • Mounting: recessed/in-wall with concealed screw mounting; mounting hardware included
  • Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
  • Multiple designer finish options available
